fusions.name: Hounding Bolt
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fresh Trail
fusions.desc: A strike on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 16 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 8% per affliction the target carries (max 40%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Downwind
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you 70% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Nose to Ground
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 15% more damage.
